title: Establishment settings
name: Establishment name
slugHint: The address of your public page. Contact support to change it.
deniedHint: Establishment settings are reserved for administrator accounts. Ask the salon administrator for access.

address.hint: Published on the salon page. Leave street, city and country empty to publish nothing.
address.incomplete: fill in the street, the city and the country, or leave the address entirely empty

hours.hint: Untick “Open” for a closing day; two ranges let you record a midday break.
hours.timezone: Hours written in the salon time zone ({timezone}), stored in UTC.
hours.format: time expected in HH:MM format (“24:00” for midnight)
hours.pair: fill in both the opening and the closing, or leave both empty
hours.order: the closing must come after the opening
hours.emptyDay: fill in a range, or untick “Open” to close the day

contact.emailHint: Leave empty not to publish an address.
contact.phoneHint: Leave empty not to publish a number.

language.label: Language of the establishment
language.hint: The language of the notifications sent to clients who have expressed no preference, and the language shown to visitors whose browser asks for neither French nor English.

verdict.successBody: The salon's public page now shows this information.

member.title: My language
member.label: Back-office language
member.hint: Applies to your account on every device. Without a choice of your own, the language of the establishment is used.
member.savedBody: The back office is displayed in this language, on every device where you sign in.
member.unavailableBody: Your account could not be read just now. Refresh the screen to set your language.
